prompt: Write an email as the teaching assistant of the "Introduction to Computer Science" course, and tell the class that we will not be meeting this week.
response_text:
Subject: IMPORTANT: Class Cancellation for Introduction to Computer Science (This Week)

Dear Students,

I am writing to inform you that we will **not** be meeting for the "Introduction to Computer Science" course this week. This applies to both the [Lectures/Labs] scheduled for [Insert Day, e.g., Tuesday and Thursday].

[Optional: Insert reason, e.g., "Due to an unexpected scheduling conflict" or "As Professor [Name] is away at a conference."]

**Please take note of the following:**

*   **Materials:** I encourage you to use this time to review the lecture slides from last week and stay current with your readings in [Textbook Name/Module].
*   **Assignments:** The deadline for [Name of Assignment] remains [Date]. Please continue to work on this and submit it via the portal as planned.
*   **Office Hours:** [Mention if office hours are canceled or moving to Zoom/Email].

We will resume our regular schedule on [Date of next class]. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.

If you have any urgent questions regarding the course material or upcoming deadlines, please feel free to reach out to me via email.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Teaching Assistant
Introduction to Computer Science
[University Name]
